texts.at-0002: Convert unit prices with to_money before storing In ledgerly/invoice.py, always normalize monetary inputs through to_money() from ledgerly.money before constructing LineItem or comparing against ZERO; this also rejects floats with a float_amount BillingError.

texts.at-0004: Exclude bool when validating integer quantities When validating integer fields like quantity in ledgerly/invoice.py, check isinstance(quantity, bool) first because bool is a subclass of int and True would otherwise pass as 1.

item.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
item.content: In ledgerly, normalize any incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (as `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py` does for `at` and `sub.started_at`).

candidate.content: Signal invalid billing inputs by raising `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` rather than ValueError or returning None; e.g. reject non-positive `period_days` with code `invalid_period`.

candidate.title: Compute periods via timedelta floor division
candidate.content: Compute billing period boundaries with `timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` and floor division `(at - start) // length`, mirroring `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`, instead of manual day arithmetic.
